name: Five Nights in Minecraft 2
summary: Five Nights in Minecraft 2 is the second installment in the Five Nights in Minecraft series, a Minecraft-styled horror game built on the mechanics of Five Nights at Freddy's 3. From an office with no lights or doors, the player watches the camera system, manages the ventilation and uses a maintenance panel to clear audio, video and ventilation errors, sealing a vent and wearing a mask to survive Springtrap and the phantom animatronics.
